benchmark.name: Aichi Open League 2026 Top 32
benchmark.primary_estimand: One fixed English-language international-Expanded-legal candidate against the unchanged original Japanese Extra opponent lists

evaluation.aggregate_prerequisite: All 32 exact source lists and independently competent rank-specific opponent policies; report every matchup and stratum

policy_panel.prototype_distance_method: Exact half-L1 source multiset distance over name+printing.set+printing.number, from Agent35's independent 29-list calculation.

ranks.prototype_distance_scope: distances to pre-existing rank-1/rank-2/rank-10 prototypes only; rank-3 policy is source-specific and not a transfer claim

candidate_pressure_summary.caveat: Exact source-list counts only; no access, timing, playability, or matchup outcome is implied.

candidate_package.caveat: Exact current candidate list counts; no gameplay, legality or performance conclusion.
